purpose: Teach: 苗/家屋/つない/下ろし/映る/はめ/お宅/森田

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 今日、ホームセンターで苗、たくさん買ってきた。
lines.en: I picked up a bunch of seedlings at the home center today.
lines.style: Light, conversational opening. Slight lift of satisfaction. Natural pace, like sharing a small accomplishment. Warm but unhurried.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 家屋の塗装、来月の話、進めてもいい?
lines.en: Should we go ahead with the house painting next month?
lines.style: Thoughtful, practical inquiry. Measured pace, eyes on the logistics. Not tentative — genuinely asking his input. Quiet confidence underneath.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: うん。電気の配線、ベランダまでつないだ業者、信頼できる。
lines.en: Yeah. The electrician who ran the wiring out to the balcony — I trust him.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Deliberate on the key detail. Calm assurance. A man who notices competence and remembers it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 屋根裏の荷物、業者に下ろしてもらおう。
lines.en: We should have the movers bring down all the things in the attic.
lines.style: Steady, methodical. Not rushing — checking off one more item. Practical without being cold. The voice of someone working through a list with a partner.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 窓ガラスに新しい雨樋、映るの楽しみ。
lines.en: I'm excited to see the new gutters reflected in the window.
lines.style: Genuine warmth surfaces here. Lighter, almost playful. The details matter to him. Small smile in the tone. Slower on the image — he's picturing it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 断熱材、しっかり壁にはめてもらってね。
lines.en: Make sure they fit the insulation snugly into the walls.
lines.style: Clear instruction delivered with quiet precision. Not bossy — the voice of someone who cares about the work being done right. Brief, direct, competent.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: お宅の隣の森田さんも、リフォーム検討中だって。
lines.en: Apparently our neighbor Morita is thinking about a remodel too.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly amused observation. Gentle pace. A moment of noticing the world beyond their own project. Warmth without commentary — just offering the thought.
